plans.idea: Classic story stack: a big headline and subhead fill the top third, the phone sits large and centred in the middle, and a wide CTA anchors the bottom, with even gaps between the three bands so nothing feels cramped.
Product first: the phone leads at the top as the visual hook, then the headline and subhead read beneath it, and the CTA closes the column, all on one left edge.

Echo of the original's split: a full-width headline block sits on top, then a two-column band below puts the CTA on the left, level with the middle of the phone, and a tall phone on the right, so the ad keeps the original's text-left / product-right feel.
